decisions.reason: As a facial-care product close to the firm's existing natural skincare know-how and given prominent presentation on its own page, it fits the firm's absorptive capacity well and is likely to be improved rather than withdrawn.

This serum is also close to the established offer, so the firm can understand customer feedback and refine it with its in-house development capabilities, although the weaker website prominence suggests slightly more uncertainty than Product A.

Facial cleansing milk lies squarely within the firm's core competence in gentle natural personal care, making retention more likely, but its only limited website visibility indicates a somewhat higher chance of later portfolio pruning than Product A.
